# Case IV: DB Has a Black Sibling Whose Far Child is Red

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Case IV: DB Has a Black Sibling Whose Far Child is Red

Consider a DB that has a black sibling whose far child is red like this.

![DB Has a Black Sibling Whose Far Child is Red](data:image/png;base64,)

To balance such cases:

1. Swap the color of the parent and the sibling of DB.
2. Rotate the parent in the direction of DB.
3. Change the DB to a single black node.
4. Change the color of the red far-child to black.

![Final Tree After Removing Double Black Node](data:image/png;base64,)
